result.instructions: Tools for SuiteDash, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the contacts created in the last 7 days and tell me which ones are still leads."; "Show everything SuiteDash has on the company Acme Corp, including custom fields."; "Create a Lead for Jane Doe (jane@example.com) and tag her 'webinar'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SuiteDash data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run suitedash_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run suitedash_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run suitedash_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. suitedash_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: suitedash_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts (leads, prospects, clients) 10 per page: name, emails, phones, role, tags, companies, address and custom fields. Filter by creation time and sort by name or creation date. GET /contacts.

created_after.description: Only contacts created after this date-time (exclusive).

created_before.description: Only contacts created before this date-time (exclusive).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 10 items per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One CRM contact by UID or primary email, with companies, tags, address and custom fields. GET /contact/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The contact's UID or email address.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_contact_fields
tools.title: Get contact field schema
tools.description: The contact field schema of this account: every default and custom field with its type, whether it is required, and which actions (read/create/update) allow it. Custom fields appear under their UID: use these UIDs in custom_fields. GET /contact/meta.

tools.name: suitedash_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a CRM contact in SuiteDash. role and names are required; email is required except for a Lead. Optionally link the contact to a company by name (set create_company_if_not_exists to create it). If send_welcome_email is true SuiteDash EMAILS the contact a portal access invitation: leave it false unless the user asked for that. POST /contact.

email.description: Primary email (required unless role is Lead).

send_welcome_email.description: Send the portal access invitation email to the contact (default false).

country.description: Country name, e.g. "United States of America".

address.description: Postal address; only the parts you pass are sent.

company_name.description: Link the contact to the CRM company with this name.

create_company_if_not_exists.description: With company_name: create the company when none matches (default false).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field UID (from the *_fields tool); text/date as a string, numbers as numbers, multi-select as an array.

tools.name: suitedash_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing CRM contact (found by UID or email); only the fields you pass change, and null clears a field. Tags and custom fields passed here replace the current values. If send_welcome_email is true SuiteDash EMAILS the contact a portal invitation (only if none was sent before): leave it unset unless the user asked. PUT /contact/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The contact's UID or current email address.

send_welcome_email.description: Send the portal invitation email if it was never sent.

country.description: Country name, e.g. "United States of America".

address.description: Postal address; only the parts you pass are sent.

company_name.description: Link the contact to the CRM company with this name.

create_company_if_not_exists.description: With company_name: create the company when none matches (default false).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field UID (from the *_fields tool); text/date as a string, numbers as numbers, multi-select as an array.

tools.name: suitedash_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List CRM companies 10 per page (idle companies are not available): name, role, category, phones, website, address, tags, primary contact and custom fields. Filter by creation time and sort by name or creation date. GET /companies.

created_after.description: Only companies created after this date-time (exclusive).

created_before.description: Only companies created before this date-time (exclusive).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 10 items per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: One CRM company by UID or exact name, with primary contact, category, tags, address and custom fields. GET /company/{identifier}.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_company_fields
tools.title: Get company field schema
tools.description: The company field schema of this account: every default and custom field (public, private and target custom fields under their UIDs) with type, required flag and the actions allowed. GET /company/meta.

tools.name: suitedash_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: create a CRM company (name and role are required) with an optional primary contact. With create_primary_contact_if_not_exists the primary contact is created from the given names/email when no contact has that email. If send_welcome_email is true SuiteDash EMAILS the primary contact a portal invitation: leave it false unless the user asked. POST /company.

create_primary_contact_if_not_exists.description: Create the contact when no contact has this email.

send_welcome_email.description: Send the portal invitation email to the primary contact (default false).

tools.name: suitedash_update_company
tools.title: Update company
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing CRM company (found by UID or name); only the fields you pass change, and null clears a field. Tags and custom fields passed here replace the current values. PUT /company/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The company's UID or current name.

country.description: Country name, e.g. "United States of America".

address.description: Postal address; only the parts you pass are sent.

public_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field UID (from the *_fields tool); text/date as a string, numbers as numbers, multi-select as an array.

private_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field UID (from the *_fields tool); text/date as a string, numbers as numbers, multi-select as an array.

tools.name: suitedash_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects 10 per page: name, status, start/end dates, due time. Filter by creation time and sort by name, creation, start or end date. Use suitedash_get_project for the client, team and economics. GET /projects.

created_after.description: Only projects created after this date-time (exclusive).

created_before.description: Only projects created before this date-time (exclusive).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 10 items per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project with its description, client and secondary clients, teammates, team, leader, economics (estimated value, currency, sector) and custom fields. Find it by UID (default), exact name, a name fragment, or the most recent one. GET /project/{type}/{identifier}.

lookup.description: How identifier is matched: uid (default), exact name, contains_the_following (name contains the text), or most_recent (identifier ignored).

identifier.description: The project UID, name or name fragment, per lookup. Not needed for most_recent.

meta.description: Also return the field schema (meta object) for each record. Rarely needed: use the *_fields tool instead.

tools.name: suitedash_get_project_fields
tools.title: Get project field schema
tools.description: The project field schema of this account: default and custom fields (under their UIDs) with type, required flag and allowed actions. GET /project/meta.

tools.name: suitedash_update_project
tools.title: Update project
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing project (found by UID, name, name fragment or most recent); only the fields you pass change. The status must be one of the account's project statuses (see suitedash_get_project_fields). The description and client text accept HTML. PUT /project/{type}/{identifier}.

lookup.description: How identifier is matched: uid (default), exact name, contains_the_following (name contains the text), or most_recent (identifier ignored).

identifier.description: The project UID, name or name fragment, per lookup. Not needed for most_recent.

status.description: Project status (one of Categories > Project Statuses).

due_time.description: Target time on the end date, HH:00 or HH:30.

business_sector.description: Business sector name (must exist in Settings > Business Sectors) (null clears it).

estimated_value_currency.description: Currency name of the estimated value (must exist in the account) (null clears it).

project_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the custom field UID (from the *_fields tool); text/date as a string, numbers as numbers, multi-select as an array.

tools.name: suitedash_subscribe_to_marketing
tools.title: Subscribe contacts to marketing audiences
tools.description: WRITE: subscribe people (by email) to one or more marketing audiences (numeric audience ids from SuiteDash > Marketing). Unknown emails may be created as marketing contacts. This enrolls real people in email marketing and can start campaigns or automations tied to those audiences: only do it for people who have consented, and only when the user asked. The reply holds the outcome per person. POST /marketing/subscribe.

tools.name: suitedash_list_worlds
tools.title: List worlds
tools.description: List the account's Worlds (client groupings), 10 per page. Only available with the WORLDS Power-Up; otherwise SuiteDash answers 403. GET /worlds.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 10 items per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
